== Build notes (October 2026) ==

Built from the four draft files, <code>swccgDrafts.json</code>, <code>DraftChoiceBuilder.java</code> and the three Watto's Cube pack classes at billbisco/swccg-gemp commit ec48dc19, compared with the same draft files at PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public commit 5e26dd19. Card counts are counted from the JSON lists. Sides come from the swccg-card-json card data, matched by GEMP card id. The draft engine code (the draft2 package) and <code>swccgDrafts.json</code> are the same in both repositories. Deck size history: commit 53f5b8e3 (pull request 256, 5 October 2026) changed Cube, the Watto's Cube formats and the four drafts from 45 to 40. The starting pool builder and the draft stage order code aren't archived, so the page only states what the JSON files list.
